notes.title: "Mayhem Maidens" Demo Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416594/2bafd63743104e5265fd37bf1915c305486268ed.png[/img]
[b]Mayhem Maidens[/b] is the official game adaptation of [b]The World Bows Down Before My Flames[/b], the first grand prize-winning novel in 12 years from Kadokawa Sneaker Bunko. Today, we are excited to launch the demo!

Mayhem Maidens is a fusion of Tower Defense and Roguelite gameplay! Take control of Homura and her four companions simultaneously, swapping them in and out strategically to adapt to the ever-changing battlefield. The freedom to plan your strategy makes this game truly unique!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416594/f1ac9bd7277a0facedce3ab362ea07ef59edf082.png[/img]

Customize your party freely by mixing and matching skills and passive abilities. Decide which characters to strengthen and tailor your strategy to fit your playstyle!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416594/5a0f2c8a822b13a372f4cf8a34a3b11ab5256255.png[/img]

With dynamic choices and unlockable content changing every time you play, each run offers fresh challenges! Experiment with skill combinations to build an unstoppable party and crush your enemies with exhilarating power!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416594/dfd0d7a66c66542fda3e03b714db7adbb6ad1dd9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416594/b0cb7f1f7025a65aea3ecb46415a92b4925fc6dd.png[/img]

Engage in conversations at your base and discover new sides to Homura and her team. Whether you're a longtime fan of the original story or a newcomer, there's something for everyone to enjoy!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416594/aa6bb499fbd1f6c0597ffd5b4e8693d18660c934.png[/img]

We will continue to improve the game based on your feedback. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3299130/discussions/0/597393274090628336/]We’d love to hear your thoughts on the demo, so feel free to share your opinions and impressions in this thread![/url]

Stay up to date with the latest Mayhem Maidens news by following [b][url=https://twitter.com/0up_games]0UP GAMES' official account[/url][/b]!
